alex_m: Heads up — I'm seeing steady RAM/GPU memory growth on the Dedicated pool when running long-context (40k-65k tokens) chat sessions. Hosted tops out earlier and Private repros but stabilizes ~20% lower. Suspect KV-cache page reuse + batching heuristics interacting badly with driver/hw on the Dedicated nodes. Anyone seen similar?

maria_r: Can you paste the exact repro command + config? which model and quantization? also which kernel selection settings (jit/optimized kernels)?

alex_m: repro: `RL_MODEL=redwood-3b-v1q --context=65536 --batch=8 --requests=2000` ran on dedicated-A100-80GB (ubuntu 22.04, nvidia 535). Flags: `--kv-evict-threshold=0.7 --batch-timeout-ms=10 --kernel=auto`. Quick log excerpt:```kv_pages_total=1_048_576 kv_pages_pinned=879_123 frag_ratio=0.61 kv_reuse_hits=0.18 mem_growth_mb=+620 peak+/-60 per-100-req```

jordan_s: hmm. profiler snippet from `/var/log/redwood/profiler/2026-02-08.log`:```KV page allocs: 1.04M
Pinned pages: 84%
Fragmentation ratio (free contiguous / total free): 0.58
Avg KV lookup latency: 0.9ms -> climbs to 2.6ms after ~1200 requests
Batching latency p50: 7ms -> p50 12ms when growth appears``` Looks like pages are being pinned and not reclaimed; reuse hit rate low.

alex_m: Dedicated had hugepages disabled (we turned it off for NUMA experiments) and the kernel had `vm.swappiness=10` vs hosted had default. Could be fragmentation due to hugepage state + the driver's allocation pattern on A100. Private runs are on 3090-style nodes with different allocator behavior so they end up slightly better.
sumi: quick experiment: try lowering `--kv-evict-threshold` to 0.45 and reduce `--batch-timeout-ms` to 6ms to force faster smaller batches and more aggressive eviction. Example: `./serve --kv-evict-threshold=0.45 --batch-timeout-ms=6 --prefetch=false` Also test `--kv-compact-interval=300s` to periodically run compaction. Can you run a 6h soak? :eyes: 

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for config change `kv-evict-threshold=0.45` on pool dedicated-A100-80GB (1/4 hosts). Monitor: /dash/infra/kv-evict-canary

ops-liz: @sumi can you coordinate the compaction change with infra? compaction can spike CPU briefly. ops wants a hold window.

alex_m: will run the soak today and dump profiler + `pmap` snapshots every 30m. Also trying kernel `hugepage=force` on a single node to see if contiguous allocations reduce frag. I'll post results.

maria_r: if this repros, we should add a regression test in perf harness: long-context soak + assert mem growth < 10% over 4h. Also add KV reuse trace to the flamegraph.

ajordan_s: cool. if the threshold fix helps we should consider an adaptive threshold: lower when frag_ratio>0.5 or when reuse drops under 0.25. I'd prefer a telemetry-driven knob rather than manual.

alex_m: agreed. starting the soak now, will paste final numbers and profiler tarball here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
